shop.name: M STUDIO
shop.description: M STUDIO is an avant-garde design house dedicated to sculptural silhouettes, industrial chrome hardware, and experimental monochrome fashion.

heroBanner.title: WHIPLASH ARCHIVE
heroBanner.subtitle: AESPA × FASHORA CAPSULE DROP
heroBanner.description: Bộ sưu tập Futuristic Cyberpunk giới hạn mang cảm hứng Y2K Techwear độc quyền.

products.name: Liquid Thorn Sunglasses
products.description: Futuristic wraparound sunglasses featuring sculpted liquid metal thorn accents and UV400 protective dark lenses.
products.careInstructions: Wipe lenses with microfiber cloth. Store in hard protective case.

products.name: Biomorphic Perforated Ring
products.description: Statement open band ring sculpted with organic hollowed textures, crafted from brushed titanium alloy.
products.careInstructions: Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, and harsh chemicals.

products.name: Sculptural Patent Shoulder Bag
products.description: Avant-garde geometric shoulder bag paneled in high-shine patent faux leather with metal rivets and an adjustable buckle strap.
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a soft damp cloth. Keep away from heat sources.

products.name: Distressed Graphic Baseball Cap
products.description: Acid-washed cotton twill baseball cap finished with distressed brim detailing and gothic screen-printed graphics.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean only. Do not machine wash or tumble dry.

products.name: Metallic Y2K Shoulder Bag
products.description: Crinkled mirror-finish shoulder bag adorned with a bold oval monogram plaque and draping ball chain hardware.
products.careInstructions: Store inside dust bag away from rough surfaces.

products.name: Oval Emblem Leather Belt
products.description: Smooth faux leather belt detailed with an oversized polished zinc alloy monogram buckle.
products.careInstructions: Hang straight or roll loosely. Avoid sharp folding.

products.name: Chrome Chain In-Ear Earphones
products.description: Wearable tech accessory combining mirrored metallic in-ear buds with decorative curb chain wiring.
products.careInstructions: Do not tug cable sharply. Keep audio jacks clean and dry.

products.name: Aerodynamic Wrap Sunglasses
products.description: Curved sports wrap sunglasses built with aerodynamic grooved temples and mirror-tinted polycarbonate lenses.
products.careInstructions: Rinse with clean water and dry using a lens cleaning cloth.

products.name: Brushed Curb Chain Bracelet
products.description: Flat curb chain bracelet in surgical stainless steel with a center cutout logo plate and lobster clasp.
products.careInstructions: Wipe with soft polishing cloth to keep shine.

products.name: Snake Chain Pendant Necklace
products.description: Fluid rounded snake bone chain necklace finished with a hollow architectural monogram pendant.
products.careInstructions: Lay flat when stored to prevent creasing or twisting.

products.name: Gemstone Spiked Crown Ring
products.description: Statement band ring designed with dramatic sharp thorn spikes and set with oval pale-blue faceted crystals.
products.careInstructions: Keep dry. Wipe gently with jewelry cloth after wearing.

products.name: Ruched Leather Cylinder Shoulder Bag
products.description: Soft gathered cylinder shoulder bag crafted in powdery blue faux leather, finished with side drawstrings and a central silver buckle plaque.
products.careInstructions: Wipe with soft damp cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals.

products.name: Heart Opal Drop Dangle Earrings
products.description: Delicate drop earrings featuring a frosted heart cabochon encased in a melted chrome border with hanging star and droplet chains.
products.careInstructions: Store in dry jewelry box. Remove before showering or sleeping.

products.name: Gothic Fleur Buckle Leather Backpack
products.description: Structured pebbled leather rucksack detailed with gothic cross appliqués, braided drawstrings, and engraved hardware buckles.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean leather. Stuff lightly when storing to maintain shape.

products.name: Faux Fur Flap Embroidered Trapper Cap
products.description: Winter baseball cap hybrid featuring plush faux-fur ear warmers, top tie ribbons, and front cursive embroidery with metal studs.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean only. Fluff fur using a soft bristle brush.

products.name: Plaid Trim Chain Beret Hat
products.description: Wool felt beret hat outlined with a monochrome tartan ribbon, detachable ball chain swag, and a front metal crest pin.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Do not wring or bleach.

products.name: Crystal Studded Pierced Skinny Tie
products.description: Dark denim skinny necktie customized with punky safety pins, horseshoe barbell piercings, and cluster rhinestone gems.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean only. Do not machine wash.

products.name: Graffiti Charm Distressed Beanie Hat
products.description: Ribbed knit skull beanie decorated with charcoal bow stencil spray art and adorned with metal safety pins and miniature cutlery charms.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash gently inside out. Dry flat on a towel.

products.name: Military Officer Jacket & Shorts Set
products.description: Cohesive tailored two-piece set featuring a structured double-breasted officer jacket with silver embossed buttons and high-waisted ribbed knit hot pants.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Do not tumble dry.

products.name: Quilted Biker Jacket & Flare Denim Set
products.description: Edgy moto coordinate consisting of a diamond-quilted leather biker jacket with asymmetric zip and low-waist washed flare wide-leg denim trousers.
products.careInstructions: Specialist leather clean for jacket. Machine wash denim cold.

products.name: Shearling Leather Jacket & Cable Knit Skirt Set
products.description: Winter layered set pairing a faux-shearling trimmed textured leather jacket with a floor-length cable-knit column maxi skirt.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Flat dry knitwear away from direct heat.

products.name: Double Collar Denim Jacket & Baggy Jeans Set
products.description: Statement denim set engineered with a sharp western cut jacket featuring layered contrasting pop-color collars and ultra-slouchy baggy jeans.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside out. Hang dry to preserve wash texture.

products.name: Architectural Funnel Leather Jacket & Zip Pants Set
products.description: Monochromatic atelier statement suit combining an asymmetric funnel-neck white leather jacket with technical spiral-zippered wide track trousers.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean jacket with damp cloth. Gentle cycle for trousers.

products.name: Colorblock Buckled Cardigan & Leather Pants Set
products.description: Asymmetric dual-tone chunky knit cardigan fitted with metal buckle strap fasteners, paired with ultra-wide faux leather puddle trousers.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean cardigan. Wipe trousers clean with a damp cloth.

products.name: Cyber Hooded Moto Jacket & Eyelet Skirt Set
products.description: Avant-garde dystopia coordinate featuring a multi-zipper hooded leather moto jacket with back slit details and a spiked metal-grommet micro skirt.
products.careInstructions: Specialist leather clean only. Keep metallic hardware dry.

products.name: Metallic Racing Leather Jacket & Mini Skirt Set
products.description: Y2K-inspired motorsport matching set composed of a stand-collar washed metallic leather jacket and a low-rise panel mini skirt with bold contrast stripe graphics.
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Do not iron or machine wash.

products.name: Cropped Biker Leather Jacket & Wide Jeans Set
products.description: Relaxed retro coordinate comprising a boxy drop-shoulder cropped moto leather jacket with waist belt buckle and loose-leg faded vintage black jeans.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean jacket. Machine wash jeans cold inside out.

products.name: Vintage Faded Balloon Jeans
products.description: Dramatic curved balloon-leg jeans in heavy stone-washed denim with whisker detailing and deep side pleats creating a sculptural voluminous silhouette.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside out. Hang dry to maintain volume.

products.name: Flame Wash Wide-Leg Denim
products.description: Wide-leg flared denim trousers featuring distinctive bleached rising flame motifs along the lower hems and subtle distress marks.
products.careInstructions: Wash separately in cold water. Do not bleach.

products.name: Distressed Eye Patchwork Cargo Pants
products.description: Heavy tactile cargo pants constructed with all-over frayed knit shredding, gothic graphic eye patch appliqués, and hanging side harness straps.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash gently. Air dry flat to preserve frayed threads.

products.name: Layered Fringe Carpenter Denim Pants
products.description: Double-knee carpenter jeans updated with Western-inspired cascading fringe tassels, raw cut hems, and oversized utility pockets.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean recommended or wash inside a mesh laundry bag.

products.name: Contour Spiral Zip Baggy Jeans
products.description: Baggy skater denim finished with fluid topographic contrast white stitching and multi-functional functional metallic diagonal zippers.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash delicate cycle. Close all zippers before wash.

products.name: Multi-Pocket Leather Cargo Trousers
products.description: Tactical wide-cut pants made from grained faux leather, featuring detachable modular waist pouches, knee harness cinches, and grommeted straps.
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Hang on wide hanger.

products.name: Grommet Strap Multi-Buckle Wide Pants
products.description: Avant-garde bondage-style wide-leg cotton pants detailed with layered zip compartments, metal eyelets, and adjustable roller buckles down each leg.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash or dry clean to protect metal buckle hardware.

products.name: Acid-Wash Multi-Pocket Cargo Jeans
products.description: Maximalist utility cargo pants constructed with an array of angled bellows pockets, curved contrast topstitching, and an aggressive mineral acid wash.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold with like colors inside out.

products.name: Cropped Satin Western Shirt
products.description: Modernist cropped button-up shirt in luminous heavy satin, featuring exaggerated western yokes, sharp notched lapels, and raw-cut hem ties.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash gently in cool water. Cool iron under pressing cloth.

products.name: Belted Moto Leather Over-Shirt
products.description: Structured boxy over-shirt tailored from supple faux leather, finished with an industrial grommet waist belt, chest flaps, and four-point star zipper pulls.
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Store away from humidity.

products.name: Scarf Collar Elastic Bomber Shirt
products.description: Voluminous hybrid zip shirt crafted from smooth wind-resistant twill with an integrated tie-scarf funnel neckline and shirred elastic waistband.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash delicate cycle. Hang to dry.

products.name: Ribbon Bow Detail Knit Cardigan Shirt
products.description: Fine-gauge v-neck knit cardigan shirt designed with tone-on-tone fabric buttons and an oversized contrast ivory bow corsage brooch.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold. Dry flat to preserve knit shape.

products.name: Asymmetric Slogan Off-Shoulder Knit Shirt
products.description: Slouchy off-the-shoulder knit top featuring raw distressed shoulder buttons and white chain-stitched front gothic typography.
products.careInstructions: Wash inside out in laundry bag. Do not tumble dry.

products.name: Oversized Graphic Moto Jersey Shirt
products.description: Dramatic drop-shoulder motocross jersey shirt featuring fluid monochrome gradient striping, script calligraphy typography, and draped long sleeves.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside out. Do not iron directly on print.

products.name: Acid Wash Distressed Hooded Shirt
products.description: Waffle-knit grunge hooded over-shirt with heavy mineral tie-dye wash, frayed raw edge hems, flared sleeves, and back minimalist text embroidery.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold or gentle cycle. Flat dry to preserve distressing.

products.name: Rhinestone Fringe Corset Top Shirt
products.description: Fitted boned satin corset top shirt styled with dual silver front zippers and cascading crystal rhinestone fringe tassels across the bust.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean only. Do not machine wash to protect crystal fringe.

products.name: Multi-Buckle Thigh-High Stiletto Boots
products.description: Statement thigh-high boots tailored from supple faux leather, detailed with multiple silver-grommeted buckle straps, inner side zip closure, and a razor stiletto heel.
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Store using boot shapers to prevent creasing.

products.name: Utility Pocket Distressed Platform Knee Boots
products.description: Gothic cyber platform knee-high boots featuring an aggressive grunge patina finish, modular zip utility shaft pockets, front lace-up detailing, and an ultra-chunky cleated sole.
products.careInstructions: Clean with dry brush. Keep away from excessive moisture.

products.name: Bleached Denim Fold-Over Stiletto Boots
products.description: Sleek pointed-toe knee-high boots wrapped in cloud-bleached treated denim with an ankle fold-over flap, brass press studs, and a sculpted heel.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean treated denim. Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight.

products.name: Distressed Leather Metal Toe Cap Derby Shoes
products.description: Classic lace-up derby shoes reimagined with heavy surface distress distressing and a bold curved metallic cage toe cap over a durable lugged rubber sole.
products.careInstructions: Brush clean and condition leather regularly. Buff metal toe guards with soft cloth.

products.name: Heavy Canvas Chunky Lug Combat Boots
products.description: Industrial high-top combat boots constructed from heavy-duty stone-washed cotton canvas, featuring an exaggerated boxy bulbous toe and deep-traction lugged soles.
products.careInstructions: Brush off dried dirt. Wipe canvas gently with damp cloth and mild soap.

products.name: Chunky Lug Sole Polished Derby Shoes
products.description: Monochromatic atelier statement derby shoes in high-shine brushed calf leather, featuring an apron toe seam and an exaggerated architectural block tread sole.
products.careInstructions: Wipe with microfiber cloth and polish with neutral wax to maintain high shine.
